{{Quote|May the Force be with you all.|Zallow's last words|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
'''Ven Zallow''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. When a pair of intruders&mdash;[[Darth Malgus]] and [[Eleena Daru]]&mdash;entered the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Zallow, accompanied by his colleagues, was quick to confront the two. Before anything could be done, a captured [[NR2 gully jumper|Republic shuttle]] full of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Warrior|warriors]] and [[Sith Inquisitor]]s crashed through the Temple's main entrance. Its passengers quickly disembarked, [[Sacking of Coruscant#Invasion of the Jedi Temple|immediately attacking]] the group of Jedi. Zallow fought against Malgus in a display of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skills, but he was soon [[Shiak|impaled]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] as the [[Sith Empire/Legends|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Sacking of Coruscant|assault]] on Coruscant began.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You assumed no force could challenge you. And now&hellip; finally, we have returned.|Darth Malgus|audio=WeHaveReturned.flac|<ref name="Trailer" />}}
Ven Zallow was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] alive during the [[Great Galactic War]],<ref name="Deceived" /> a conflict begun in [[3681 BBY]] when the forgotten [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] emerged from hiding to combat the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> It was around this [[Time/Legends|time]] that Zallow trained his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Aryn Leneer]], to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knighthood]]; when she reached the rank, Zallow gave her a [[Nautolan tranquillity bracelet]].<ref name="Deceived" /> In [[3653 BBY]], twenty-eight years after the war's beginning, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces contacted the Republic with their wish to negotiate an end to the conflict. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], sworn defenders of the Republic, were skeptical of the Sith's intentions, but they realized that they had little chance of winning the war and decided to see if peace was really possible.<ref name="Timeline 1" /> Leneer had been selected as one of the Republic's delegates to the [[Alderaan peace conference|peace conference]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and Zallow saw her off as she departed [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Republic. Unknown to the Republic, the Sith planned to use the talks as a diversion as their forces moved in on the Republic capital.<ref name="Deceived" />

[[File:TempleDuel-Deceived.png|thumb|left|250px|Zallow duels Darth Malgus during the Invasion of the Jedi Temple.]]
Zallow was present at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant when [[Darth Malgus]] and his lover, [[Eleena Daru]]&mdash;members of a Sith advance force in preparation for their attack&mdash;proceeded to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Temple Security Force|Temple security guards]] that were trying to bar them from entering the Temple. As the pair of intruders strode in, Zallow&mdash;accompanied by his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding allies, who had taken up positions flanking him on numerous levels&mdash;positioned himself in front of Malgus without a word, his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] locked on Malgus's. Before either opponent could act, a captured [[NR2 gully jumper|Republic shuttle]] crashed through the Temple's main entrance, damaging the surrounding area and skidding to a stop behind Malgus. The Jedi held their ground for a moment as the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] came to a halt. The shuttle's hatch opened, revealing a strike force of at least twenty-five Sith warriors who ignited their lightsabers and engaged the assembled Jedi and members of Temple Security in a pitched battle.<ref name="Deceived" />

After immobilizing the Twi'lek by [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Throw|throwing her]] against a stone pillar, Zallow was alerted<ref name="Trailer" /> by his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companion, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]],<ref name="T7-O1">{{HolonetOld|biographies|t7-o1|T7-O1}}</ref> to an impending strike from Malgus. He and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] engaged in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], and the Jedi held his own against his opponent. He was knocked back by a roundhouse kick, using the opportunity to strike at a pair of Sith before leaping into the air as Malgus [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber Throw|threw his lightsaber]] at his adversary, narrowly missing the blade. However, while he was still airborne, Malgus [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force pushed]] him through a mound of rubble.<ref name="Trailer" />

Malgus pulled his lightsaber back to his hand as he [[Force jump/Legends|Force jumped]] over the rubble and, bringing his weapon in a killing strike, drove it into the floor where Zallow had been only a moment earlier. The Jedi, however, had [[Force speed/Legends|evaded]] the strike and once again engaged Malgus in blade-to-blade combat, even landing a blow to his enemy's face with the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] of [[Ven Zallow's lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. Ultimately, he was no match for Malgus, opening himself up to a fatal [[Shiak|thrust]] through his abdomen. As he lay dying, the Sith Lord told him how the Jedi Order had been deceived, and that the Republic would fall as a result. Zallow's last sight was that of the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]] in flames, with scores of Sith [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Warship/Legends|warships]], and ground forces continuing the attack on the capital world,<ref name="Trailer" /> a battle that would culminate with the death of the Republic's [[Berooken|Supreme Chancellor]] and the destruction of the Temple itself.<ref name="Threat of Peace">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref> Malgus saw to it that the Temple served as Zallow's and the others' final resting place.<ref name="Deceived" />

On Alderaan, Leneer felt Zallow's death and immediately realized that the negotiations had been a ruse. When the talks concluded, she reflected on Zallow's passing and vowed to face her Master's killer.<ref name="Deceived" /> When Leneer reunited with T7-O1 on [[Odessen]] after confronting Malgus, it reminded her of Zallow and how grateful he would have been to know that the droid found a home. Leneer also wondered what Zallow would have wanted Leneer to do after she left the Jedi Order and concluded that he would have wanted her to continue helping others.<ref name="Path">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|The path that lies ahead.|Aryn Leneer}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Ven was a human male with [[Color|brown]] hair, green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. Zallow was a wise, composed Jedi Master whose presence in the Force greatly comforted his onetime apprentice, Aryn Leneer.<ref name="Deceived" /> When Darth Malgus and Eleena Daru breached the Temple's defenses, Zallow led his comrades in confronting the two in a standoff. Even as the captured Republic shuttle crashed through the building's main entrance, the Jedi stood his ground while his companions took a few steps back. When the Sith emerged from the craft, Zallow joined his allies in defending the Temple, soon rushing to combat Malgus in an ultimately fruitless attempt.<ref name="Trailer" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Despite his allegiance to Jedi blasphemy, he at least appears to grasp the truth of improvement through combat.|Darth Malgus, on Zallow|<ref name="BookSith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
[[File:SaberThrow2-Deceived.png|thumb|right|250px|Zallow narrowly avoids a lightsaber thrown by his Sith opponent.]]
Ven Zallow was one of the most renowned Jedi of his era, being regarded as Darth Malgus' most famous kill.<ref name="Malgus Holonet">{{HolonetOld|biographies|darth-malgus|Darth Malgus}}</ref> This made him even more renowned than [[Kao Cen Darach]], the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]], who fell to Malgus earlier in his career.<ref name="Return">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> Zallow's skill with his lightsaber was such that he was able to cut down several [[Sith Warrior]]s and [[Imperial soldier|Sith troopers]] with little difficulty. Even Lord [[Adraas]], Malgus' long-time rival, was unable to overcome Zallow during the Sacking of Coruscant.<ref name="Deceived" /> Malgus himself respected Zallow's skill with a blade, and was eager to personally engage him in combat. During a short but fierce duel, Zallow managed to strike Malgus in the face with the hilt of his lightsaber but was ultimately slain by a thrust through the abdomen.<ref name="Trailer" />

Zallow displayed a wide variety of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] during the invasion of the Jedi Temple; namely, telekinetic feats such as Force Jump and Force speed when avoiding the lightsaber attacks of Malgus, who ultimately killed him. He was highly acrobatic, even without the aid of the Force. Furthermore he was proficient in the use of Force Push which he used to incapacitate Malgus' lover, Eleena Daru, during the battle.<ref name="Trailer" />

==Equipment==
[[File:BladeEmitterShroud-Deceived.png|thumb|left|250px|Ven Zallow's lightsaber, which his apprentice Aryn later found]]
Ven Zallow wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and battle armor. He wielded a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed lightsaber in both training and in combat, up until the moment of his death. His lightsaber was of greater heft and length than that of his Padawan, Aryn Leneer, who later acquired and kept the weapon after it was discovered in the rubble of the leveled Jedi Temple on Coruscant by Zallow's T7-O1 astromech droid. Both Master and apprentice—the latter of whom in the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] style—used the lightsaber on different occasions against the Sith Lord Darth Malgus, the same man who killed Zallow while Coruscant itself was [[Sacking of Coruscant|laid to waste]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ven Zallow first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the "Deceived" cinematic trailer<ref name="Trailer" /> released on [[June 1]], [[2009]], to promote the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''<ref name="Released">{{TORweb|url=news/article/20090601_002|text="Deceived" Cinematic Trailer Released!|nolive=1}}</ref> Darth Malgus's Holonet entry on ''The Old Republic'' website, published on [[April 30]], [[2010]],<ref name="Biographies">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100430_001-0|text=HoloNet Biographies Updated!|nolive=1}}</ref> introduced a Jedi named Ven Zallow as Malgus's most notable kill.<ref name="Malgus Holonet" /> It was confirmed in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', released on [[March 22]], [[2011]],<ref name="Publishing Calendar">{{Blog|eeusuestornii|15|Newest Publishing Calendar &mdash; Fiction AND Non-fiction!}}</ref> that Zallow was indeed the Jedi killed by Malgus during the "Deceived" cinematic.<ref name="Deceived" />
